meta.note: Redesign made in this design system; ahead of the code. Sizes, radii and component anatomy still follow src/design.rs.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window body: a thin tinted pane, 72% (Dark) or 85% (Light), over a blurred, saturated backdrop. The backdrop is also levelled (dimmed on Dark, lifted on Light) so no wallpaper can wash out text. Tested for contrast at exactly this strength.

tokens.name: bg_solid
tokens.usage: The same body with no glass. Use when transparency effects are off, on battery saver, in high contrast, and as the ground behind standalone components.

tokens.name: bg_elevated
tokens.usage: Things that pop over the window: ActionPanel, Dialog. A step lighter than the body on Dark, pure white on Light, and all but opaque, so nothing underneath reads through it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, Field, KeyCap, untinted IconTile, the SegmentedControl track. An alpha wash: one blended fill, no extra layer.

tokens.name: surface_strong
tokens.usage: Chips, the current segment, the off Toggle track, hover on the Back tile.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Under the mouse. Always lighter than a selected fill, so the two never look alike.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, bg_solid, bg_elevated, surface and the selected fill. Also the icon on an IconTile in a selected row.

tokens.name: text_muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, descriptions, KeyCap labels; on bg (worst wallpaper), surface, bg_elevated and the selected fill: 4.5:1.

tokens.name: text_faint
tokens.usage: Section labels, placeholders, row accessories; on bg (worst wallpaper) and on surface: 4.5:1.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers: under the SearchBar, over the ActionBar, the SectionHeader rule. Decorative.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outer edge of the window, Field, KeyCap, Quiet Button, popovers. Decorative: the fill names the control, the accent border names focus.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The bright end of the glass rim: top-left of the 1px border around every glass surface, and the inner top highlight.

tokens.name: edge_dim
tokens.usage: The quiet end of the rim: the border fades to this toward the bottom-right, as light falls off around the pane.

tokens.name: sel_top
tokens.usage: Top of the selected lozenge: a brighter, clearer piece of glass. Neutral, never a hue.

tokens.name: sel_bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the selected lozenge; the fill runs from sel_top to this.

tokens.name: sel_ring
tokens.usage: The 1px inner ring that gives the selected lozenge its edge.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Monochrome: the text colour. Caret, search mark, focus border and ring, Toggle on, the one Primary Button, and the selection pill. Hue belongs to icons only.

tokens.name: accent_text
tokens.usage: Text and the Toggle knob on accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot in the ActionBar.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot; the "Press ↵ again to confirm" line in the ActionBar: 4.5:1 on bg at its worst.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger Button fill, the destructive Dialog glyph, error status dot, Tint::Danger rows.

tokens.name: danger_text
tokens.usage: Text on danger: 4.5:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a Dialog, over the whole window: the window is out of play until it is answered.

tokens.name: scrim_soft
tokens.usage: Behind an open ActionPanel, over the whole window: the list steps back but stays readable.

tokens.name: tint_accent
tokens.usage: procast's own commands: monochrome, like the accent.

tokens.name: tint_system
tokens.usage: System: lock, sleep, restart, shut down, dark mode. Kind tints colour an icon and its tile only, never a selection. Icon in the hue on a 14% wash of it with a 24% rim; in a selected row the icon steps up to text.

tokens.name: tint_window
tokens.usage: Window layouts.

tokens.name: tint_paste
tokens.usage: Clipboard, emoji, snippets.

tokens.name: tint_web
tokens.usage: Quicklinks, web and AI fallbacks.

tokens.name: tint_file
tokens.usage: File search.

tokens.name: tint_calc
tokens.usage: The calculator.

tokens.name: tint_danger
tokens.usage: Clearing history, quitting apps.

styles.name: ts-query
styles.usage: The search field: what you typed is the largest text in the window.

styles.name: ts-display
styles.usage: Page headings and the calculator answer.

styles.name: ts-heading
styles.usage: Second-level headings. The calculator question uses this size at weight 400 in text_muted.

styles.name: ts-body
styles.usage: Rows and body text. The window default.

styles.name: ts-body_sm
styles.usage: Subtitles, accessories, the ActionBar, Button, segments.

styles.name: ts-caption
styles.usage: KeyCap labels. Weight 500 keeps the grotesk legible at this size.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Only inside controls: the SegmentedControl track, the Toggle inset, label to description.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: KeyCap gaps, ActionPanel padding, list padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Row inset, Field padding, label to icon, Dialog stack gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Icon tile to title, Button padding, SearchBar gap, ActionBar shortcut gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: SearchBar and ActionBar side padding, Dialog padding, SectionHeader inset.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between cards and page sections in Settings.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: KeyCap, segments inside a control.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Field, Button, chips.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Rows (Selectable) and IconTile.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, ActionPanel, Dialog, CalculatorCard.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: The launcher window on glass. Concentric with what it holds: 16 outside, an 8 px inset, 8 on the rows.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: accent at 32%, 2px spread, no blur. Always paired with a solid 1px accent border.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: Only on ActionPanel and Dialog: a deep, close shadow that separates them from the window beneath. Nothing in the list casts a shadow.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: Thickness: a bright line inside the top edge and a shade inside the bottom edge. Window, ActionPanel, Dialog.

tokens.name: depth
tokens.usage: The wide soft shadow that lifts the glass window off the desktop.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: SearchBar height.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: One list slot; the row box inside it is 36. Every slot is this tall so the list virtualises with no measuring.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: ActionBar height.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: The icon box: vector icons sit centred in it, app images draw at 24 inside it.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Field, Button, dropdowns, ActionPanel rows, sidebar rows; segments are 28 inside a 32 track.

tokens.name: cap
tokens.usage: KeyCap, Toggle height, colour swatches.

tokens.name: list_pad
tokens.usage: Above and below the list, so the window holds whole rows.

tokens.name: ic-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside KeyCap, chips and dropdowns.

tokens.name: ic-md
tokens.usage: Icons in the ActionBar, ActionPanel rows, notices.

tokens.name: ic-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in IconTile, the search mark, checkboxes.

tokens.name: ic-xl
tokens.usage: EmptyState and Dialog icons.

tokens.name: ic-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width of every icon on its 24-unit grid.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind bg. In the app this is the OS backdrop (DWM acrylic), requested once for the window; procast draws no blur itself. This value is for previews and web mock-ups.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation, so wallpaper colour survives the blur and tints the pane.
